service.method: SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.COMPANY_CODE , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC , LANG.CONTENTS MENU_PROFILE_NAME FROM (SELECT MENU_PROFILE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,HOUSE_CODE FROM SMUPD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND MENU_PROFILE_CODE <> 'COMMON' GROUP BY HOUSE_CODE, MENU_PROFILE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE) MUPD JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE JOIN SLANG LANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANG.SCREEN_ID ='MENU_PROFILE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND ( 1=1 AND LANG.CONTENTS LIKE '%'|| $S{F_KEYWORD} ||'%' OR MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE LIKE '%'|| $S{F_KEYWORD} ||'%' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN MENU_PROFILE_CODE = 'ADD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , MENU_PROFILE_CODE

SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.MENU_ID , MUPD.PARENT_MENU_ID , #DB_OWNER#nvl(PDLANG.CONTENTS, PDLANG_DEFAULT.CONTENTS) MENU_NAME , MUPD.SCREEN_ID , MUPD.ITEM_SEQ , MUID.URL , MUID.MOBILE_URL , MUID.AUTH_URL , #DB_OWNER#nvl(MUPD.MENU_IMG, MUID.MENU_IMG) MENU_IMG , MUID.SUMMARY_FLAG , MUPD.ETC_FLAG , MUPD.HIDDEN_FLAG , MUID.ATTACH_NO , MUPD.MODULE FROM SMUPD MUPD LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG PDLANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = PDLANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_ID = PDLANG.CODE AND PDLANG.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU_' || MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE AND PDLANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG PDLANG_DEFAULT ON PDLANG_DEFAULT.HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND MUPD.MENU_ID = PDLANG_DEFAULT.CODE AND PDLANG_DEFAULT.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU_' || MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE AND PDLANG_DEFAULT.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SMUID MUID ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = MUID.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = MUID.SCREEN_ID WHERE MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${profile_no} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUPD.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND MUPD.HOUSE_CODE= ${session.HOUSE_CODE} ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID , CAST(#DB_OWNER#NVL(ITEM_SEQ,'0') AS INT)

SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.COMPANY_CODE , MUPD.MENU_ID , MUPD.PARENT_MENU_ID , MUPD.SCREEN_ID , MUPD.ITEM_SEQ , MUID.URL , MUID.MOBILE_URL , MUID.AUTH_URL , NVL(MUPD.MENU_IMG, MUID.MENU_IMG) MENU_IMG , MUID.SUMMARY_FLAG , MUPD.ETC_FLAG , MUPD.HIDDEN_FLAG , MUID.ATTACH_NO , MUPD.MODULE FROM SMUPD MUPD LEFT OUTER JOIN SMUID MUID ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = MUID.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = MUID.SCREEN_ID WHERE MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${menu_profile_code} AND MUPD.MENU_ID <> '0' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID , TO_NUMBER(#DB_OWNER#NVL(ITEM_SEQ,'0'))

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , SCREEN_ID , URL , MOBILE_URL , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , MENU_IMG , SUMMARY_FLAG FROM SMUID WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SCREEN_ID = ${screen_id}

SELECT SCREEN_ID ,PARENT_MENU_ID ,ITEM_SEQ ,DEL_FLAG ,ETC_FLAG ,HIDDEN_FLAG ,ICON_TYPE ,MODULE FROM SMUPD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.house_code} AND MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${menu_profile_code} AND MENU_ID = ${menu_id}
DELETE FROM #DB_OWNER#SMUPD WHERE MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${menu_profile_code}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.VALUE) AS ROW_NUM__ FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT MUID.SCREEN_ID AS TEXT , MUID.SCREEN_ID AS VALUE , MUID.SCREEN_ID , LANG.CONTENTS , MUID.URL , MUID.MOBILE_URL , MUID.MENU_IMG , MUID.SUMMARY_FLAG , MUID.HIDDEN_FLAG , MUPD.MODULE FROM SMUID MUID LEFT OUTER JOIN SMUPD MUPD ON MUID.HOUSE_CODE = MUPD.HOUSE_CODE AND MUID.SCREEN_ID = MUPD.SCREEN_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_ID = LANG.CODE AND LANG.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG.SCREEN_ID like 'MENU%' ) A WHERE 1=1 AND A.TEXT like '%' || $S{MASK} || '%' AND A.VALUE like $S{VALUE} ) B WHERE B.ROW_NUM__ <= 10
